purpose: Slugs whose LEARNED signature is known to be the wrong person. The audit drops the learned clusters for these and uses the hand-picked /admin/faces crop instead. Without this, saved_crop_anchors skips anyone who already has a learned signature, so a corrected crop would never reach the recognition profile. Keep this list short and evidenced: it overrides multi-photo learning with a single frame.
